rules.rule: This is a test file. Review it alongside the diff: flag weakened assertions, deleted tests, invented evidence, or hardcoded expected values that were never actually measured.
Reduced-motion mode must replace rotation, shake, roll, FOV punch, and rotated glitches with cuts, wipes, and static displacement.
Reading is never timed: no countdown, auto-advance timer, or timeout may be attached to reading text. Flag any.

All randomness must route through the seeded RNG and its forks — warmup use, visual randomness included. Flag Math.random() and Date.now()-based gameplay randomness. Determinism contract: same seed and inputs must reproduce the run.
Fixed vocabulary: public names Light/Shadow/Ambition, code ids luminary/shadow/ambition. Flag identifiers using mischief, wrath, or trickster.
Colour never carries meaning alone — every important cue needs shape, motion, label, or sound as well. Flag colour-only differentiators.
